import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

**Do this after `bob-cli-on` promotion lands.** Store drawers as list-item headings (`- ## API Design`), keep identity case-folded, and paint the row as a nested H2. Glued `#foo` tags are the wrong mark.

Report: `research:202611/mixed_case_task_drawers/mixed_case_task_drawers__grk.md`  
Artifact: `file:explicit:968218bcd9b25c7d8328923b`

### Recommendation
ALL-CAPS currently does three jobs at once: recognition, display, and identity. That is why promotion runs `format_project_section_title` and turns `API DESIGN` into `Api Design`. Split those jobs:

- **On disk:** `- ## API Design` under the task. Promotion unwraps the list marker; reversal wraps it. Same heading bytes.
- **Identity:** keep `drawer_key` as uppercase-collapsed. `Notes` / `NOTES` still merge.
- **Capture:** reuse the notebook matcher and create-title formatter (`#API-keys` already becomes `API Keys`). Write `- ## Title` under a task and a real column-0 `## Title` on notebooks / `^prj`. The leading `- #slug` shortcut stays; it rewrites away.
- **Render:** nested-heading chrome (heading weight, quiet left rule, conceal `## ` until the caret is on the line). Skip small-caps, which would hide the casing this change exists to keep.

### `#foo` tags
The instinct is right. A glued hashtag on the drawer line enters Obsidian’s note-level tag index and shares the `#` vocabulary with `#task`, types, and clock tags. Hash-space (`- # Title`) is also weaker than `- ## Title` (looks like an H1; promotion would have to add a hash).

### `bob-cli-on`
Stay off `is_drawer_title` twins, NOTES scoop, promotion (`.12`), and rename-drawer casing until that epic lands. Dual-read legacy ALL-CAPS so existing vectors keep passing. Recase `NOTES` → `Notes` as a follow-on after the `^prj` notes home is `## Notes` (already a recorded bug on that bead).

Migration prefixes `## ` onto existing ALL-CAPS titles and leaves the letters alone. Recasing is `bob task rename-drawer`, not a heuristic.
